story.title: Helping The Needy
paragraphs_en: Once a upon a time their was a girl named Shifa. She used to help poor people. When she was at the age of 18 she starting standing up against cruel people who did not like to help the poor and treated them badly. She told people to help the poor.

When she grew up she invited a poor man to her house for food. She felt bad that the poor man was wearing torn clothes so she gave him new clothes to wear. Then her heart felt better. She was very happy to help the poor man.

Poor man gave her lots of wishes and blessings. Her kids were also happy that they helped the needy. One day the kids were playing and they saw a child wearing ton clothes and crying. They went near her and said why are you crying.

The child said, I am crying because I don't have food to eat , I don't have clothes , toys and parents. I am also not felling well. The kids said Oh don't worry come with us. The came home with the poor child.

They gave her food, new clothes and toys and they said we will drop you to the adoption Centre. Their mother said when ever you feel like meeting us you can come we would also come to meet you. Like this they continued to help the needy happily.

sentences.text_en: The child said, I am crying because I don't have food to eat , I don't have clothes , toys and parents.

sentences.text_en: I am also not felling well.
The kids said Oh don't worry come with us.
sentences.text_vi: Các bạn nhỏ nói: "Ôi, đừng lo, đi với bọn tớ nhé!"

sentences.text_en: The came home with the poor child.
sentences.text_vi: Chúng đã về nhà cùng với đứa trẻ nghèo đó.

sentences.text_en: They gave her food, new clothes and toys and they said we will drop you to the adoption Centre.
sentences.text_vi: Họ cho cô bé đồ ăn, quần áo mới và đồ chơi, rồi nói: "Chúng tớ sẽ đưa cậu đến trung tâm nhận nuôi."

sentences.text_en: Their mother said when ever you feel like meeting us you can come we would also come to meet you.
sentences.text_vi: Mẹ của chúng nói: "Bất cứ khi nào con muốn gặp chúng ta, con có thể đến, chúng ta cũng sẽ đến thăm con."

sentences.text_en: Like this they continued to help the needy happily.
sentences.text_vi: Cứ thế, họ tiếp tục giúp đỡ những người cần giúp một cách vui vẻ.
